description.en: Sets the current match phase/half and the remaining duration for it (e.g. switching to the second half with a given number of seconds left).
Numeric match phase/half to switch to.
Duration (in seconds) to set for that phase.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if fewer than 2 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Switch to match phase 1 with 300 seconds remaining
CMND_BTL_SET_MATCH_PHASE(1, 300);
